title: Quantum Machine Learning Using Quantum Illumination With Quantum Enhanced Interference
summary: Quantum Machine Learning(QML) is developed by combining quantum mechanics principles with classical machine learning techniques in a hybrid framework that can give faster, exponential, more efficient power of quantum computing with the data driven intelligence. Quantum illumination(QI) is the quantum mechanical technique along with analysis of light matter interaction from source to detection end that connects quantum principle to hardware implementation.
